# FLX-3665: a response family sits on a journey whose reactions the World's temperature dials

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A World that declares the campaignResponse dial allocates each journey step's frozen share over a group of subjects, and splitting that group by segment and arm would move subjects the family does not touch. Remove the dial from the World, or the family.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3665
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
